§6Fiberglass§f

§aTwice as good as polymer insulation. Once you have peroxide, switch everything over.§f

Fiberglass is a synthetic silicate glass fiber polymer used for high-grade insulation. You get it from the §bOre Acidizer§f using §bHydrogen Peroxide§f.

Production: §bOre Acidizer§f with §e500mB§f Hydrogen Peroxide + §bSand§f = Fiberglass Bar. A Mining Laser on sand with a crystallizing upgrade also works.

Insulation-wise, fiberglass gives §e16§f units per recipe compared to §e8§f for polymer-based options (Teflon, Bakelite, rubber). Same crafting layout: two bars side by side.

Fiberglass is also used in the Soyuz Rocket, FEnSU power storage, Breeding Reactor Core, and can be processed into silicon in the Arc Furnace.

§ePS:§f Fiberglass bars compact into Rolls of Fiberglass (block form), useful as construction material.
